profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer/Section Manager at Raytheon

positions.title: Section Manager
positions.description: Manage software engineers for the JPSS team in addition to software lead responsibilities.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Lead for the Orbit Operations and Mission Management teams.  Also software lead for the Modernization team focusing on containerizing some of our ground systems.  Worked extensively on our orbit operations software that models our satellite and performs operations like orbit determination, propagation, event prediction and maneuver modeling.  Experience porting software to run in Kubernetes as docker containers using helm charts.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description: Orbit Operations software lead developing algorithmns and code for orbit determination, orbit propagation, maneuver planning and various orbit maintenance related tasks.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer on the Orbit Operations team in the Command, Control and Communcations team on the JPSS project.
